# MIRAGE (19 · mirage)

A vaporwave collective — slatted sun, chrome type, marble statue, all pure CSS and gradient.

- **Technique:** PURE-CSS 3D
- **Tags:** vaporwave, retro, music, nostalgic, surreal, neon, 90s, dreamy
- **Best for:** record labels; musicians & merch; creative collectives
- **Fonts:** Monoton, Poppins
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Monoton&family=Poppins:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #1a0b2e · #ff5e9e · #58e6e6
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/mirage/` (Template.astro, content.ts, drops.ts, meta.ts, stars.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* mirage — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --dusk: #1a0b2e;
  --dusk2: #241040;
  --horizon: #3c1a63;
  --night: #12081f;
  --pink: #ff5e9e;
  --peach: #ffd97a;
  --cyan: #58e6e6;
  --lilac: #b79df0;
  --tx: #f4eefc;
  --dim: #a893c9;
  --faint: #5f4d85;
  --white: #fff;

  /* Hero sky: between --dusk2 (top) and the horizon glow. */
  --sky-1: #5b2472;
  --sky-2: #a04586;
  --sun-deep: #c23a8f;
  --floor: #2a1250;

  /* Chrome title gradient (middle and bottom bands; top bands use --white, --cyan, --lilac). */
  --chrome-mid: #2e7ea8;
  --chrome-low: #7a5bbf;

  /* Marble statue */
  --marble-hi: #f2ecfa;
  --marble-mid: #c9b8e8;
  --marble-lo: #8f74c4;

  /* Drop cover backdrops, one per art kind */
  --art-cassette: #2b1552;
  --art-vhs: #40195e;
  --art-minidisc: #1c2a5e;

  --neon: "Monoton", cursive;
  --body: "Poppins", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `drops.ts`
  - `dropArt(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Fill every `[data-art]` element with its neon line drawing; `data-label` is the text printed on it.
- `stars.ts`
  - `stars(wrap: HTMLElement)` — Scatter twinkling stars (`<i>` dots, animated in CSS) across `wrap` at random positions and sizes.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<br>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Line-art cover drawing for a drop (generated SVG in drops.ts). */
export type DropArt = 'cassette' | 'vhs' | 'minidisc';

export interface Drop {
  title: string;
  /** Format line under the title, e.g. "Cassette · C60 · Chrome". */
  format: string;
  /** Price line in peach. */
  price: string;
  art: DropArt;
  /** Short text printed on the drawn cover (cassette label, tape sticker, disc shutter). */
  artLabel: string;
}

export interface Transmission {
  /** Schedule block in the left column; use <br> for the second line. */
  whenHtml: string;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  /** Right-aligned location tag. */
  place: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Logo text in nav + footer. */
  logo: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** Chrome headline over the sunset. */
    title: string;
    /** Spaced-out subtitle under the headline. */
    subtitle: string;
    tagHtml: string;
  };
  drops: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Drop[];
  };
  manifesto: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** The quote, including its typographic quote marks; wrap emphasis in <b>. */
    quoteHtml: string;
    cite: string;
  };
  transmissions: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Transmission[];
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```

- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style mirage --out <dir>`
